subject: Finovent MAP: EU data residency, retention windows & SOC2 / SIG coordination
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@finovent.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@finovent.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + MAP ask: EU residency, retention windows, SIG/CAIQ

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — really good fit so far. Procurement asked I start the security intake now so we don't slow the buying timeline. A couple of asks so we can slot Redwood into our MAP:

- Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to EU data residency for customer content and logs? We expect production data and PII to stay in EU, with a preferred region (Frankfurt).
- Data retention windows: what are typical default retention windows for chat transcripts, trace logs, and debug artifacts? We need retention policy options (30/90/365 days) and the mechanism to request shorter/longer windows.
- SOC 2: do you have a current Type II report and when is the next audit window?
- SIG/CAIQ: we attached our shortened SIG questionnaire (Finovent_SIG_questions_v1.pdf). Can you return it with answers in two weeks?

Timeline: our procurement lead wants a MAP that aims for contract signature by 2026-06-10. Can Redwood commit to a MAP with security milestones that supports that date?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m call if helpful.

—Asha
Security Lead, Finovent
attachments: Finovent_SIG_questions_v1.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@finovent.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP ask: EU residency, retention windows, SIG/CAIQ

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a draft MAP (redwood_map_draft_20260512.xlsx) and a short plan below. We'll treat this as the working mutual action plan and iterate with you.

High level answers up front:
- EU residency: yes — Redwood can run a dedicated customer tenant in eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). We'll surface region as a deployment option on sign-up and we can include an EU-residency clause in the DPA.
- Retention windows (default + options):
  - Chat transcripts: default 90 days; configurable to 30 / 90 / 365 via account settings and enforceable via contract appendix.
  - Trace logs (operational traces & debug artifacts): default 30 days; longer retention available on request for compliance programs with SLA impact.
  - KV/prefix caches: ephemeral by default; we recommend explicit mention in DPA for customers wanting longer-term retention.
- SOC 2: current Type II report available (covering controls through 2026-03-31). We will provide the report under NDA. Next audit window Q1 2027.
- SIG/CAIQ: we'll return the questionnaire with answers; Ben will handle the technical responses and Kimberly will handle control/policy items and DPA redlines. Expect a completed SIG draft in ~7 business days.

Proposed MAP (milestones, owners, target dates):
1) Intake & evidence request — Owner: Ben Carter — Target: 2026-05-14 — deliverables: SIG answers (draft), SOC2 stub under NDA, list of accessible regions.
2) DPA redline pass — Owner: Kimberly Park — Target: 2026-05-18 — deliverables: redline_dpa_finovent_neha_v1.docx.
3) Technical walkthrough & staging plan — Owner: Ben Carter — Target: 2026-05-20 — deliverables: staging runbook, test account in eu-central-1.
4) Final SIG answers & SOC2 delivery under NDA — Owner: Ben / Neha — Target: 2026-05-21.
5) Contract negotiation & signatures — Owner: Procurement / Kimberly — Target: 2026-06-02 (preferred internal signoff), final signature by 2026-06-10.

Action items for you (Asha):
- Confirm whether Finovent requires EU-only processing for metadata/telemetry as well as customer content (we can support both, but need to know scope).
- Confirm whether 90-day default transcript retention is acceptable or if you require 30 days.
- Provide contact for procurement (we assume procurement@finovent.com) and legal for DPA routing.

I attached the draft MAP spreadsheet — we can convert that to a HubSpot mutual action plan record (HubSpot id in related_links) once you confirm. Kimberly — I'm looping you for the DPA redline lane. Ben — can you pick up the SIG?

If helpful, I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Friday (May 14) to review intake items.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
phone: +1-415-555-0172
attachments: redwood_map_draft_20260512.xlsx
From: Asha Rao <asha@finovent.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@finovent.com>, procurement@finovent.com
Date: 2026-05-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP ask: EU residency, retention windows & SIG/CAIQ

Neha — this looks good, thanks. Quick clarifications from our side: 
- We need EU-only processing for both customer content and metadata (logs/telemetry). Can you confirm if telemetry routing to EU is a managed option or requires Dedicated/Private deployment?
- For transcripts, 90 days is acceptable for now; procurement will confirm the retention appendix preference in the contract stage.
- Procurement contact is procurement@finovent.com (same as above) and Liam will be our legal point for the DPA redline (liam@finovent.com).

On timing: the 2026-06-02 internal signoff target is realistic but depends on turnaround for the DPA redline and the SIG answers. We'll hold a slot on our side for a 2026-05-20 technical walkthrough.

I'll upload the completed SIG PDF with our annotations by 2026-05-14. Also: our security team will want evidence for key management (KMS/HSM), proof that backups are geo-restricted, and a sample of the log-retention policy applied at account level.

Thanks — can we run the onboarding staging in a sandbox eu account first?

—Asha
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@finovent.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@finovent.com>, procurement@finovent.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP ask: EU residency, retention windows & SIG/CAIQ

Thanks Asha — confirming items and next steps. Replying inline to your clarifications and locking the MAP dates: 

- EU-only processing: supported in Hosted by selecting eu-central-1 region during provisioning; telemetry and operational logs can be routed to EU buckets and separated per-tenant. This is available without Dedicated, but for strict contractual data isolation we recommend Redwood Dedicated or Private deployment; we'll note the option in the DPA appendix.
- KMS / HSM: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via integration with customer KMS (AWS KMS / Cloud HSM). We'll include the KMS integration guide and a screenshot of the KMS bindings in the evidence packet.
- Backups geo-restriction: we can restrict backups to the selected region and document the backup lifecycle. Evidence: backup policy excerpt and sample retention configuration (deliverable in intake step 1).
- Sandbox eu account & staging: confirmed — Ben will provision a staging tenant in eu-central-1 by 2026-05-20 for the technical walkthrough.

Locked MAP deliverables/dates (finalized):
• 2026-05-14 — Intake: SIG draft, SOC2 stub, region confirmation (Owner: Ben)
• 2026-05-18 — DPA redline (Owner: Kimberly)
• 2026-05-20 — Technical walkthrough + staging access (Owner: Ben)
• 2026-05-21 — Final SIG answers & NDA'ed SOC2 report (Owner: Ben / Neha)
• 2026-06-02 — Internal signoff target (Finovent & Redwood)
• 2026-06-10 — Target signature date

Open asks for Finovent:
1) Please confirm whether the DPA needs an EU-residency SLA clause vs. an annex (we can do either).
2) If you have any CAIQ-specific questions that need a deeper dive, flag them now so Ben can prepare a short demo for the walkthrough.

I'll attach a short evidence index after Ben compiles the SIG answers. Kimberly — I'll ping for the DPA redline draft; if you can target EOD 5/18 that keeps us on the MAP.

Thanks all — I'll set a 30-minute invite for 2026-05-20 to review the staging runbook.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
